title: e.l.f. Beauty targets 50% clean electricity use in product manufacturing by 2032
summary: The company’s 50% clean electricity goal for 2032 was reported in e.l.f. Beauty’s new impact report, which details how the owner of Hailey Bieber’sRhode is making an environmental and social impact

extraction.key_fact: e.l.f. Beauty가 임팩트 리포트에서 제품 제조에 쓰는 전력의 절반을 청정 전력으로 바꾸겠다는 목표를 밝혔다.
